final: SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS department_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () - AVG(1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM member AS mb JOIN major AS m ON CAST(m.major_id AS TEXT) = CAST(mb.link_to_major AS TEXT) GROUP BY m.department HAVING 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () > AVG(1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) OVER ()
